workspaces.title: My workspaces
workspaces.description: You're a member of these workspaces. The same account and the same computer work for all of them.
workspaces.empty: You haven't joined any workspace yet. Contact an admin.

language.title: Language / 语言
language.description: This is an account setting. The web app, coding tools (MCP), the member CLI and session reminders all follow it, on any computer.
language.label: Account language
language.unset: Not set (the web follows your browser; coding tools and the CLI use the server default language: {{name}})

bind.title: Pair a new computer
bind.description: Let the coding tools on this computer use the Cohive server as you.
bind.step1: 1. Install the CLI and pair this computer
bind.noCli: This server doesn't include a CLI installer. Contact a server admin.
bind.unixIntro: macOS and Linux: run in a terminal
bind.unixLabel: Install and pair on macOS and Linux
bind.after: When it finishes, your browser opens. Click Authorize. Version {{version}}. It downloads only from this server and verifies the checksum before installing. It installs to ~/.local/bin (the current user's folder on Windows) and needs no admin rights. Run it again on a computer that already has the CLI to upgrade.
bind.alreadyInstalled: If the CLI is already installed and you only need to pair:
bind.step2Desc: This writes the coding tool configuration (no tokens, so it's safe to commit to the repo). Skip it for projects where a teammate has already committed these files.
bind.step3: 3. Open the web app without a password later
bind.step3Desc: On a computer that's already paired, run cohive web to open this page without a password.

devices.title: My devices
devices.description: Every computer you've paired. Revoke a computer that's lost or no longer in use. Its sign-in stops working immediately.
devices.empty: No computer paired yet. Use the commands above to pair your first one.
devices.revokeOnlyMessage: “{{name}}” is the only computer you're using. After you revoke it, none of your coding tools can reach the Cohive server, and pairing a computer again needs admin approval.
devices.revokeMessage: After you revoke it, the coding tools on “{{name}}” immediately lose access. To use this computer again, run cohive login and wait for an admin to approve.

chat.title: Chat apps
chat.description: Once connected, issue notifications in the chat group @-mention you, and admins can approve requests with buttons right in the group.

telegram.unlinkMessage: After you disconnect, group notifications no longer @-mention you. You can reconnect any time.
telegram.waiting: Waiting for you to finish in Telegram…
telegram.opened: The Telegram bot opened in a new window. Click Start in Telegram. This page updates automatically when you're done.
telegram.expired: The connection request has expired. Click Connect Telegram again. {{detail}}
telegram.pollStopped: Couldn't check the connection result: {{message}}. Click Connect Telegram again.
telegram.pollRetry: Couldn't check the connection result: {{message}}. Retrying shortly.
telegram.badLink: The link returned by the Cohive server isn't a Telegram bot link, so it was not opened
telegram.notEnabled: The Cohive server has no Telegram bot enabled. Contact a server admin.

dingtalk.name: DingTalk
dingtalk.pollRetry: Couldn't check the status: {{message}}. Retrying shortly.
dingtalk.unlinkMessage: After you disconnect, group notifications no longer @-mention you, and you can't approve requests with buttons in DingTalk groups. You can reconnect any time.
dingtalk.waiting: Waiting for you to send the code in DingTalk…
dingtalk.notEnabled: The Cohive server has no DingTalk enabled. Contact a server admin.
dingtalk.instructions: In DingTalk, open a direct chat with the bot Cohive (tap the bot's avatar in a group, then Send message, or search for the bot by name) and send it the code below. It's valid for 10 minutes.
dingtalk.codeWarn: Send the code to the bot in a direct chat only. Posting it in a group invalidates it immediately.
dingtalk.confirmPrompt: The bot received a link code from DingTalk user {{name}}. Is that you? It connects only after you confirm.
dingtalk.expired: The link code has expired. Click Connect DingTalk again. {{detail}}

group.name: DingTalk group
group.unbindMessage: After you unbind, group notifications and approval messages are no longer sent to this group. You can generate a new code to bind again.
group.otherBound: This workspace is already bound to a group in another chat app. Unbind it first to bind a DingTalk group.
group.instructions: First add the Cohive bot to the project's DingTalk internal group (group settings, then Robots, then Add robot). Then @Cohive in the group and send this message exactly as shown:
group.expiry: Valid for 10 minutes and can be used once. This page updates automatically after binding succeeds.
group.expired: The group code has expired. Generate a new one.
